$comment: The single source of truth for colour, marks and type. Edit here, then run `node scripts/build.mjs`. Light-mode shades of each accent are derived by the build (see docs/colour.md), not written by hand.

text.$comment: P2: text and icons use the platform's label colours. On iOS and macOS use the system's .primary/.secondary; these values mirror Apple's for the web.

lit.$comment: The fill of the selected or lit thing and of the primary button. Never a text colour on its own.

states.$comment: Shared by every product. Never an accent.

lab.$comment: Lab tools only: something is waiting on your answer.

type.body: Each product's choice. The system font (SF) is the default on Apple platforms.

lyrate.name: Lyrate
lyrate.mark: The Riffle: seven pages fanned through 90°, fading at full strength from an ink front page to a sea-glass back page.

avia.name: Avia
avia.mark: A tent, lit face and shade face (the app's own art layers).

tern.name: Tern
tern.mark: A lowercase t and a cursor: the stem with its hooked foot, the crossbar a step down, and the cursor lit. The app's own icon, kept.

site.name: Site
site.mark: The initials ir in three pieces: the i's stem, an r drawn as one hooked stroke, and the i's dot in the accent.

paperside.name: Paperside
paperside.mark: Four comic panels; the top-right one lit.

hocin.name: Hocin
hocin.mark: The Throw: a projector's beam in three even bands, running at full strength from an ink tip to the screen's blue, landing on a slim lit screen. The beam is also Play.

homelab.name: Homelab
homelab.mark: The Home rack: a roof over two server blades, the top blade's status light lit and the lower one's off.

otto.name: Otto
otto.mark: A cream head with two pill eyes. Lives in Homelab; not an app icon.

library.name: Library
library.mark: A shelf: three spines stepping down, the fourth leaning in the accent.

books.name: Books
books.mark: An open book, its pages and cover dipping to the spine, with a bookmark ribbon in the accent. Shares Lyrate's sea glass: both are for reading.

primer.name: Primer
primer.mark: The cited line: a page of lines with one cited passage lit.

undercut.name: Undercut
undercut.mark: A tyre in dark rubber with its compound band in the accent.

proser.name: Proser
proser.mark: Two voices: a pair of opening quotation marks, mine in ink and the agent's in rose.
